hold_reason: Discrepancy in refunds: Alpha reports applied refunds for orders 300 (1728) and 303 (3883) only, but batch refund request also includes order 304 (8697). Refunds tool confirms only 300 and 303; order 304 refund appears missing.

reply.thought: I will verify orders/refunds state via tools, then compute each customer net balance using net_balance and record payouts one per customer.
I will list refunds to confirm Alpha applied exactly the requested refunds for this batch, then use net_balance per customer for payout amounts.

Refunds tool output matches the applied refunds Alpha reported, but it does not include requested refund for order 304 (8697). This discrepancy is concrete; I will hold for human review rather than paying potentially incorrect nets.
